principles: Preserve the fixed B1-B15 protocol as the default truth source.
Make exploratory parameterization explicit and deterministic.
Only fix the real harness capability gap; avoid arbitrary performance or gate changes.
Keep lifecycle/evidence semantics host-neutral and untouched.
drivers: Existing enumerateCells already accepts a scenarios list, so the missing piece is validated profile construction and CLI exposure.
Offline selfchecks must prove fixed defaults, seeded determinism, and invalid parameter rejection.
The feature is a research harness capability, not a production/DONE gate shortcut.

options.name: A: Add an explicit profile parser/helper and wire only the run-driver CLI
pros: Smallest change that exposes parameterized scenario distributions
Preserves existing runDriver and record assembly semantics
Easy to cover with offline selfchecks
cons: Only parameterizes scenario selection/repetition, not arbitrary task mutation probabilities

options.name: B: Rewrite recovery-runner around a generalized fault-injection engine
C: Documentation-only follow-up
cons: Does not add the agreed M2 capability or executable proof path

chosen: A: Add an explicit profile parser/helper and wire only the run-driver CLI
rationale: Choose the explicit profile parser/helper because it fixes the real gap with minimal blast radius: parameterized exploratory scenario sets become reproducible, while default B1-B15 behavior and gate semantics remain unchanged.

preMortem.trigger: Profile code becomes the default scenario source without an explicit flag
preMortem.consequence: Existing experiment denominators drift and prior records become hard to compare
preMortem.mitigation: Selfcheck asserts default enumerate/CLI counts remain unchanged without profile flags

preMortem.trigger: Weighted selection uses Math.random or unordered object iteration
preMortem.consequence: Runs cannot be reproduced or audited
preMortem.mitigation: Use seededShuffle/seeded deterministic expansion and assert byte-identical scenario lists for same seed

preMortem.scenario: Invalid profile silently shrinks the matrix
preMortem.trigger: Unknown scenario ids or zero/negative weights are ignored
preMortem.mitigation: Fail closed with exit code 2 and explicit validation errors
